'''Building 49-A''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]].

==Description==
Building 49-A was the only cantina on Almas. It was a two-story pre-fabricated unit that was located north of the planet's [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Many of its patrons were [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]], such as the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Kressis]].

==History==
In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] began poisoning [[kaluthin]] plants on Almas, threatening the livelihoods of Almas' farmers. Around this [[Time/Legends|time]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lo Pelkar]] and [[Rulo]] visited the cantina, resulting in a tense stand-off, because the farmers incorrectly believed that the Jedi were responsible for the death their crops.
